row.body: The mobility service card lists a vehicle test before delivery; the battery check is marked complete before the technician signed in.
row.title: Luxury vehicle setup

sidecar.gloss: A vehicle check is complete before the technician arrives.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency vehicle could receive a fast battery check before dispatch; the card does not identify the test.

row.body: the paperclip box and hand radio were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
row.title: missing count beside the paperclip box

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
